verdict.rationale: Evidence only vaguely references running 'the latest AI models locally' and mentions 'Ollama, PyTorch, and other inference backends' as supported on RTX AI PCs, but there is no documentation of FP8/FP4 low-precision support, nor any mention of TensorRT-LLM, vLLM, or llama.cpp specifically for this part. Missing for 10: explicit FP8/FP4 precision specs, named support for TensorRT-LLM/vLLM/llama.cpp serving stacks, and any benchmark or independent corroboration of LLM inference performance on the 5070 Ti.
